Pinned to niri v26.04. All literal keys, tags and container shapes below are
wire-exact. Angle-bracket values are type placeholders, NOT wire strings;
`null / T` means null or T. Named placeholders refer to the value sections.
Typed encoding emits every known field, including explicit null for absent
options. Received optional record fields may be omitted. Required fields never
receive CLI-derived defaults. Typed outbound values reject unknown fields and
variants; received unknown data is retained. Raw access remains unrestricted.

QML reads u64/usize/i64 as decimal strings and absent options as real null.
Typed inputs also accept exact integral Number values, but cannot recover an
integer already rounded by JavaScript. Use strings for arbitrary caller IDs.
u32 and smaller integers remain numeric, with checked native width/range.
Enums/unions expose kind, known, valid, wireName/tag and raw; inactive payloads
are null. Invalid construction exposes valid=false and an error, never a
default success. Records expose read-only fields and retained extensions.

## Requests

All 16 requests accept trailing `options = {}` with timeoutMs/connectTimeoutMs.
Picks default timeoutMs=-1 (no response deadline); explicit overrides apply.
eventStream() observes the session's actual acknowledgement and leaves the
stream open. It never opens a one-shot socket, and late calls reuse the current
actual acknowledgement. Cancelling an observer does not stop the shared stream.
returnError() expects Err and reports it through the common error contract;
unexpected Ok is Decode. All completion is queued and replies are retainable.

## Typed replies

Each of the 14 response kinds has an uncreatable named pending-reply subclass.
`result` is read-only, notified with finished; native result() returns the
canonical C++ value. Success requires the expected discriminator and complete
validated payload. Decode failures retain the raw envelope and fieldPath.
Every reply envelope is exactly `{"Ok":<Response>}` or `{"Err":<string>}`.
Inherited value is the QML convenience projection; Handled remains the string
"Handled", while result is a niriHandled unit gadget with wireName="Handled".

| # | Reply | Native result() | QML result | Exact Ok response |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `NiriCastsReply` | `QList<NiriCast>` | `list<niriCast>` | `{"Ok":{"Casts":[<Cast>, ...]}}` |
| 2 | `NiriFocusedOutputReply` | `std::optional<NiriOutput>` | `null / niriOutput` | `{"Ok":{"FocusedOutput":null / <Output>}}` |
| 3 | `NiriFocusedWindowReply` | `std::optional<NiriWindow>` | `null / niriWindow` | `{"Ok":{"FocusedWindow":null / <Window>}}` |
| 4 | `NiriHandledReply` | `NiriHandled` | `niriHandled` | `{"Ok":"Handled"}` |
| 5 | `NiriKeyboardLayoutsReply` | `NiriKeyboardLayouts` | `niriKeyboardLayouts` | `{"Ok":{"KeyboardLayouts":<KeyboardLayouts>}}` |
| 6 | `NiriLayersReply` | `QList<NiriLayerSurface>` | `list<niriLayerSurface>` | `{"Ok":{"Layers":[<LayerSurface>, ...]}}` |
| 7 | `NiriOutputConfigChangedReply` | `NiriOutputConfigChanged` | `niriOutputConfigChanged` | `{"Ok":{"OutputConfigChanged":<OutputConfigChanged>}}` |
| 8 | `NiriOutputsReply` | `QMap<QString, NiriOutput>` | `map<string, niriOutput>` | `{"Ok":{"Outputs":{"<arbitrary string>":<Output>, ...}}}` |
| 9 | `NiriOverviewStateReply` | `NiriOverview` | `niriOverview` | `{"Ok":{"OverviewState":<Overview>}}` |
| 10 | `NiriPickedColorReply` | `std::optional<NiriPickedColor>` | `null / niriPickedColor` | `{"Ok":{"PickedColor":null / <PickedColor>}}` |
| 11 | `NiriPickedWindowReply` | `std::optional<NiriWindow>` | `null / niriWindow` | `{"Ok":{"PickedWindow":null / <Window>}}` |
| 12 | `NiriVersionReply` | `QString` | `string` | `{"Ok":{"Version":<string>}}` |
| 13 | `NiriWindowsReply` | `QList<NiriWindow>` | `list<niriWindow>` | `{"Ok":{"Windows":[<Window>, ...]}}` |
| 14 | `NiriWorkspacesReply` | `QList<NiriWorkspace>` | `list<niriWorkspace>` | `{"Ok":{"Workspaces":[<Workspace>, ...]}}` |

## Events

The 19 native and QML signals below publish the SAME decoded event after the
coordinator's existing state updates. Generated buses do not parse or cache.
Native C++ uses NiriEvents::nativeEvents() (not invokable from QML). The QML
singleton inherits the projected signals. An epoch change during a native
callback suppresses the stale QML/raw continuation.

| # | QML signal | Native C++ signal | Exact event wire shape |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `castStartedOrChanged(cast: niriCast)` | `castStartedOrChanged(const NiriCast &cast)` | `{"CastStartedOrChanged":{"cast":<Cast>}}` |
| 2 | `castStopped(streamId: string)` | `castStopped(quint64 streamId)` | `{"CastStopped":{"stream_id":<uint64>}}` |
| 3 | `castsChanged(casts: list<niriCast>)` | `castsChanged(const QList<NiriCast> &casts)` | `{"CastsChanged":{"casts":[<Cast>, ...]}}` |

| 5 | `keyboardLayoutSwitched(idx: number)` | `keyboardLayoutSwitched(quint8 idx)` | `{"KeyboardLayoutSwitched":{"idx":<uint8>}}` |
| 6 | `keyboardLayoutsChanged(layouts: niriKeyboardLayouts)` | `keyboardLayoutsChanged(const NiriKeyboardLayouts &layouts)` | `{"KeyboardLayoutsChanged":{"keyboard_layouts":<KeyboardLayouts>}}` |
| 7 | `overviewOpenedOrClosed(isOpen: bool)` | `overviewOpenedOrClosed(bool isOpen)` | `{"OverviewOpenedOrClosed":{"is_open":<boolean>}}` |
| 8 | `screenshotCaptured(path: null / string)` | `screenshotCaptured(std::optional<QString> path)` | `{"ScreenshotCaptured":{"path":null / <string>}}` |
| 9 | `windowClosed(windowId: string)` | `windowClosed(quint64 windowId)` | `{"WindowClosed":{"id":<uint64>}}` |
| 10 | `windowFocusChanged(windowId: null / string)` | `windowFocusChanged(std::optional<quint64> windowId)` | `{"WindowFocusChanged":{"id":null / <uint64>}}` |
| 11 | `windowFocusTimestampChanged(windowId: string, focusTimestamp: null / niriTimestamp)` | `windowFocusTimestampChanged(quint64 windowId, std::optional<NiriTimestamp> focusTimestamp)` | `{"WindowFocusTimestampChanged":{"focus_timestamp":null / <Timestamp>,"id":<uint64>}}` |
| 12 | `windowLayoutsChanged(changes: list<niriWindowLayoutChange>)` | `windowLayoutsChanged(const QList<NiriWindowLayoutChange> &changes)` | `{"WindowLayoutsChanged":{"changes":[[<uint64>,<WindowLayout>], ...]}}` |
| 13 | `windowOpenedOrChanged(window: niriWindow)` | `windowOpenedOrChanged(const NiriWindow &window)` | `{"WindowOpenedOrChanged":{"window":<Window>}}` |
| 14 | `windowUrgencyChanged(windowId: string, urgent: bool)` | `windowUrgencyChanged(quint64 windowId, bool urgent)` | `{"WindowUrgencyChanged":{"id":<uint64>,"urgent":<boolean>}}` |

| 17 | `workspaceActiveWindowChanged(workspaceId: string, windowId: null / string)` | `workspaceActiveWindowChanged(quint64 workspaceId, std::optional<quint64> windowId)` | `{"WorkspaceActiveWindowChanged":{"active_window_id":null / <uint64>,"workspace_id":<uint64>}}` |
| 18 | `workspaceUrgencyChanged(workspaceId: string, urgent: bool)` | `workspaceUrgencyChanged(quint64 workspaceId, bool urgent)` | `{"WorkspaceUrgencyChanged":{"id":<uint64>,"urgent":<boolean>}}` |
| 19 | `workspacesChanged(workspaces: list<niriWorkspace>)` | `workspacesChanged(const QList<NiriWorkspace> &workspaces)` | `{"WorkspacesChanged":{"workspaces":[<Workspace>, ...]}}` |

Known event bodies must be objects before any field lookup. Malformed known
events emit decodeError(path, message, payload) then rawEvent(name, payload),
with no default typed signal or state update. Unknown variants emit
unknownEvent(name, payload) then rawEvent. rawEvent is retained for ALL events.
Its payload is QVariant/var, not QVariantMap: object bodies remain objects,
malformed scalar/array/null bodies remain intact, and future unit variants
retain their original string. Raw integers use the lossless raw projection.
